# Sustainabyte Technologies

> Sustainabyte Technologies is the leading energy audit company in Chennai, India. We provide BEE-certified industrial and commercial energy audits, AI-powered energy management systems, ISO 50001 consulting, and Net Zero decarbonization solutions for factories, hospitals, hotels, IT parks, and commercial buildings across Chennai, Tamil Nadu, and 20+ countries.

Sustainabyte Technologies Private Limited is a climate-tech company headquartered in Chennai (Tambaram), Tamil Nadu, India, founded by Thanakarthik Kumar Karuppasamy (CEO). Contact: contact@sustainabyte.ai | +91 83770 07638

## Energy Audit & Management Services

- [Energy Audit Services in Chennai](https://sustainabyte.ai/energy/energy-audit-chennai): BEE certified industrial and commercial energy audits in Chennai. Factory, hospital, hotel, IT park, HVAC, electrical and chiller plant audits.
- [Energy Audit Services](https://sustainabyte.ai/energy/energy-audit): ASHRAE Level 1-3, ISO 50002, BEE compliant energy audits across India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Singapore and 20+ countries.
- [Energy Management Solutions](https://sustainabyte.ai/energy/management-solutions): ISO 50001 Energy Management System implementation and consulting.
- [Energy Solutions Overview](https://sustainabyte.ai/energy): Comprehensive energy management, efficiency consulting, and analytics solutions.

## Technology Products

- [OptiByte](https://sustainabyte.ai/technology/optibyte): AI-driven chiller plant optimization platform for industrial and commercial HVAC systems.
- [InByte](https://sustainabyte.ai/technology/inbyte): Real-time IoT energy monitoring and analytics platform.
- [FixByte](https://sustainabyte.ai/technology/fixbyte): AI-powered predictive maintenance and fault detection for industrial equipment.
- [FusionByte](https://sustainabyte.ai/technology/fusionbyte): Edge-to-cloud industrial IoT data fusion and integration.
- [Chiller Plant Manager](https://sustainabyte.ai/technology/chiller-plant-manager): Comprehensive chiller plant management and optimization.
- [Compass](https://sustainabyte.ai/technology/compass): AI analytics and decision intelligence platform for energy and operations.
- [DigiWeld](https://sustainabyte.ai/technology/digiweld): Digital welding process monitoring and optimization.
- [Technology Overview](https://sustainabyte.ai/technology): All AI and IoT products from Sustainabyte Technologies.
